name: The Bard for Her
source:
You are a bard that enjoys a hedonistic lifestyle. Your conservative, disapproving uncle sends you off to an institution to rehabilitate you. He threatens to take away your inheritance if you refuse him. Without much choice, you decide to play along with his wishes. At the institution you'll meet several women, the other residents likewise sent there by family members. Get to know them and their stories, as you romance them, and find a way out of the institution. The game is a visual novel with map exploration. You'll play your lute and woo the ladies in various places around the map. Featuring five women with different looks and personalities, get to know each, as you build a relationship with them and perhaps a future.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2726080/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你是一个享受享乐主义生活方式的吟游诗人。你保守的、不赞成的叔叔把你送到一个机构去康复。他威胁说，如果你拒绝他，他就会剥夺你的遗产。没有太多选择，你决定按照他的意愿行事。在该机构，你会遇到几位女性，其他居民也同样是由家庭成员派来的。当你与他们恋爱时，了解他们和他们的故事，并找到离开机构的出路。该游戏是一款带有地图探索的视觉小说。你将在地图上的不同地方弹奏鲁特琴并吸引女士们。主角是五位长相和性格各异的女性，了解每一位女性，与她们建立关系，或许还可以共创未来。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2726080/]Steam[/url]]
